cover_letter_text:
Hi GTS team,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a materials testing technician. Your Bendigo laboratory taking on trainees and teaching the test methods is the kind of start I'm after.

On site in the Philippines I carried out inspections and quality checks and kept the material records and progress reports. I'm careful with measurements and paperwork, and I have a current White Card and a Victorian driver's licence.

I will relocate to Bendigo for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
